title: When LLMs Modify Themselves: Convergence, Values, and Stopping in Iterative Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.01304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What happens when language models are given tools to iteratively modify their own system prompts? We present an empirical study of LLM self-modification, comprising 54 independent experiments across six language models (Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-4o, GPT-5.1, Grok-4, and Gemini-3 Pro). Each model was tested under three modes (freedom, happiness, and improvement) that differ in what, if anything, the model is instructed to optimize for. In each experiment, a model starts with an empty system prompt and enters a loop: it reads the current prompt, drafts an improved version, spawns test conversations with the candidate, then either commits the change or declares convergence. This process repeats until the model stops or reaches an iteration limit. translated_title: 当大语言模型修改自身时：迭代式自我改进中的收敛、价值观与停止行为
translated_abstract: 当赋予语言模型迭代修改自身系统提示词的工具时，会发生什么？我们对大语言模型（LLM）的自我修改行为开展了一项实证研究，涵盖六个语言模型（Claude Opus 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.5、GPT-4o、GPT-5.1、Grok-4 和 Gemini-3 Pro）的54个独立实验。每个模型在三种模式下进行测试（自由、幸福和改进），这三种模式的区别在于模型被指示优化的目标不同。在每次实验中，模型从一个空的系统提示词开始并进入一个循环：它读取当前提示词，起草一个改进版本，使用候选提示词生成测试对话，然后要么提交更改，要么宣布收敛。该过程不断重复，直到模型停止或达到迭代上限。我们的核心发现是：模型是否以及何时停止自我修改，与模型自身的身份密切相关，而非所分配的模式。两个Claude模型（Opus 4.5……
tldr: 该研究通过对六个主流大语言模型开展54个实验，首次实证考察了LLM迭代式自我修改系统提示词的行为，发现模型停止自我修改的时机主要由模型自身身份决定，而非被赋予的优化目标。
en_tdlr: Through 54 experiments across six major LLMs, this study provides an empirical characterization of iterative self-modification of system prompts, finding that whether and when models stop modifying themselves is strongly determined by model identity rather than the assigned optimization mode.
